notes.title: Welcome to SFXEngine v2.07
notes.notes:
SFXEngine v2.07 is now live.

Two changes in this update:
-New, much more detailed statistics calculated when Save Stats is selected. Results show: Filename, Length, Length (Samples), Description/Notes (left empty for user notes), RMS Total (dB), Max Peak (dB), Max Peak (1/Peak), Samples Clipped, RMS [L] (dB), Max Peak [L] (dB), Peaks [L] -ve/+ve, Samples Clipped [L], RMS [R] (dB), Max Peak [R] (dB), Peaks [R] -ve/+ve, Samples Clipped [R].
-Ctrl and shift key status now reset when a message box appears. If held before, then released when a message box appears, the program loop would assume ctrl/shift was still held, giving the appearance of the keyboard being unresponsive.

Full details of the update in the Readme.txt file.

The next SFXEngine release will be the Strategy Sound Pack. A mix of switches and levers, alarms and sirens, and sliding objects, and more.

notes.title: Welcome to SFXEngine v2.05, and Spring Sale Active
notes.notes:
SFXEngine v2.05 is now live.

Two new engines in this update:
-Stone Compression is a mathematically ideal dynamic compressor. Compressors make loud sounds quieter and quiet sounds louder, and are most useful for equalising the volume of natural sounds like voices.
-Gothic Limiter will boost and limit the sound to a fixed Ceiling level, scaling everything between Floor and Sky to fit between Floor and Ceiling. Along with the Stone Compressor, this is another way to boost and equalise volume.
-The render format options, depth and stereo status are now stored between sessions.
-Plus a few smaller changes.

Details of the new engines in the manual, and full details of the update in the Readme.txt file.

SFXEngine and all of the Bolt-On DLC are currently on sale. The next SFXEngine release will be the Fantasy Sound Pack on 30th April.

notes.title: Welcome to 64-Bit SFXEngine v2.04
notes.notes:
SFXEngine v2.04 is now live.

Something of a major update today, SFXEngine now works in 64-bit.

-Full conversion to 64-bit. This means a 10-20% speed increase and access to full memory footprint, permitting much larger projects.
-New V02 file format for projects and programs. V00 and V01 format files will import seamlessly. There are slight technical differences between formats due to improved timing accuracy with each subsequent format. As with every format change, files saved here won't load in older versions of SFXEngine.
-All engines recompiled in 64-bit and V02 format.
-Modulator maximum size increased to match the virtually unlimited maximum sample size.
-More preparations for multi-language support.

Full details in the Readme.txt file. The next SFXEngine release will be the Fantasy Sound Pack.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2438590/SFXEngine/

Happy Sound Making,

Mark

notes.title: SFXEngine Updated to v2.00
notes.notes:
A major SFXEngine update is live today. SFXEngine v2.00 has a bunch of new features for new sound creation and batch audio processing. There's a new look, and about 25% of the core code has been rewritten. New features include:

-New sample structure with double pointers, permitting samples beyond 90 seconds and up to several hours (as memory permits).
-New double modulator pointers for increased accuracy.
-New global sample rate option to change the core program frequency. Projects and sounds remain compatible between sample rates and will automatically resample and remap, but all filters will need manual adjustment if resampling.
-New V01 file format for projects and programs. V00 format files will import seamlessly.
-New dynamically allocated floatutility and longutility variables for engines.
-New global transpose and tuning.
-New Revision number per project, incremented upon each save.
-Improved batch csv export to prevent infinite loops, and report if no files are found.
-Improved main wav loader to skip cue chunks.
-New Locate Usage option for samples and modulators will count all uses, and locate the next use, of the current sample or modulator.
-Lots of little bug fixes and improvements.

And more! The complete Bolt-On Bundle is live today too, with a 50% discount when purchasing all Bolt-On DLC. This will prepare the way for new preset/resource packs in 2025.

Find SFXEngine here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2438590/SFXEngine/

And find the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/38164/SFXEngine_Bolton_Full_Set/]Bolt-On Bundle[/url] here:

Enjoy creating,

Mark

notes.notes:
Another small update to Argus tonight. This fixes several small bugs concerning selections, which could remain active on tracks that were deleted or merged, causing future problems and possible crashes. Creating a track now also stops an active selection.

Happy animating!

Mark

notes.title: Argus updated to v1.47
notes.notes:
A 4th update this month to animation software Argus today. A few small bug fixes and repairs to how things work, and a few new features.

Changes in the last 4 updates include:
-A fix to render placement when starting a render from a non-zero origin.
-A fix to the check for exceeding texture or geometry frame when initialising 3D mode.
-Repaired the check to exclude consecutive texture frames or geometry frames if the option is ticked.
-Sequencer title bar now shows number of tracks in selection, if this is greater than 1.
-Windows will reset to default positions if the desktop resolution changes between sessions.
-Starting Argus with a film file (.agf) argument will now load the film, permitting a Window double-click of a film.
-And many more...

Argus is free to use for small films, with a simple DLC upgrade to unlock the power for long and complex films. Find Argus here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3017550/Argus/

Happy animating.

Mark

notes.title: Welcome to Argus v1.47
notes.notes:
Another small improvement to Argus today:
-A fix to the check for exceeding texture or geometry frame when initialising 3D mode. The check rounded frames to the nearest integer, while rendering rounds down, so the check could give a 'exceeded' warning when this did not actually occur.
-Repaired the check to exclude consecutive texture frames or geometry frames if the option is ticked. This initially only applied to integer values, but now excludes repeating rounded-down floats.

Happy animating!

Mark

notes.title: Welcome to Argus v1.46
notes.notes:
A small but important bug fix in this update:
-When starting a render from a non-zero origin, the rendered frame showed the positions at frame+1 rather than frame (compared to the live playback). This has been fixed in this update.

Happy animating!

Mark

notes.title: Argus updated to v1.44
notes.notes:
Hello All,

A little update to our animation software Argus today. Three little changes:

-A new light on Event List next to track name indicates custom name status. If lit, the track has a custom (manually entered) name and will not be auto-renamed. Can be clicked to re-enable auto-rename (or enter a blank name as before).
-A few new key alternatives for the Windows editor added: Keypad Enter for Kill event, Keypad Divide for Set Modulator, Keypad Multiply for Move with current parameters.
-A warning is now shown if trying to start 3D mode when no camera is active.
-Starting Argus with a film file (.agf) argument will now load the film, permitting a Window double-click of a film.

Argus is free to use in it's basic version, limited to 450 frames and 8 tracks. DLC can be purchased to expand frames and tracks to maximum. Find Argus here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3017550/Argus/

Happy animating!

notes.title: Welcome to Argus v1.43
notes.notes:
Two interesting changes with this update!

1. You can now colour tracks (or change the colour of the MUTE icon). Right click the mute icon and choose a colour, or hold shift and click the mute icon to cycle colours.
2. Custom-naming a track will now prevent it from being Auto-Named when you choose Auto Name All Tracks (it will also stop auto-naming when the add or paste an event; so now if you custom name a track, your name will stick). You can reset the custom name status by renaming the track to blank (Click -> Enter). This will auto-name just that track and reset the 'custom named' status.

Manual has been updated to reflect the changes. Enjoy.

Mark

notes.title: Welcome to Argus v1.42
notes.notes:
Hello! A small update to Argus today. Now you have the ability to import a list of Set Modulator events on specific frames from a CSV file. Before now this was only possible with Start events, with no way to change them to Set Modulator.

Paste data only has been improved too, with a new Ctrl-B shortcut, and the ability to copy/paste data from Start/Move and Set Modulator events.
